title: AuraxNova Command v5: WPF AI desktop shell
summary: A .NET 8 WPF desktop app from January 2026: a main shell with chat, an avatar whose glow follows a simulated mood (the endocrine system), a code IDE window, dev tools, a literature writer, a market terminal, a media window, notes, a social panel and a WebView2 window for the web platform. Its Core folder holds about 90 C# modules: a universal AI API, memory and RAG, a tool registry, speech, vision, hardware monitoring, a Python bridge and the Gemma/LLamaSharp local model interface.
works: Compiles with the .NET SDK (checked with .NET SDK 10.0, targeting .NET 8) once its NuGet packages restore. Five build breaks in the original source are fixed in this copy.

Complete enough to study end to end: the WPF windows and their code-behind, and about 90 Core modules (AI providers, memory and RAG, tools, speech, vision, hardware monitoring, the Python bridge and local Gemma through LLamaSharp).
unfinished: Not run end to end for this release. Expect features that only log, show placeholders, or need services you set up yourself.
Every key, the license master keys and the owner bypass values were removed. Google sign-in, Firebase, Gemini and the other cloud features need your own credentials before they work.
The activation window still has a built-in 'Catalyst' bypass path (now with placeholder values). Remove it before you ship anything.
Many paths point at folders on the original PC (E:/AuraNova_DataLake and others). Change them in Core/AuraPaths.cs and in the modules that hard-code them.
The Python scripts the bridge launches and the local AI models are not included, so the Python bridge and local AI need your own scripts and GGUF models.
RestSharp 110.2.0 has a known moderate vulnerability; update it. The build prints about 900 warnings, mostly nullable reference warnings.
notIncluded: Aura's original memory and personality files (aura_NovaFiles), the AI models (Models/, about 9 GB) and the Z-Image-Turbo demo.
The older copy of the web platform (Aura Nova OS Complete). The NovAura Web OS template is the current version of it.
The old documentation, which calls this build production-ready and carries earlier licenses. PROTOTYPE-NOTICE.md and LICENSE-NOVAURA-TEMPLATE.md replace them.
Images at the project root that the code does not use.
requirements: .NET 8 SDK (or newer) with the Windows desktop workload
Visual Studio 2022 or the dotnet CLI
Your own API keys for any cloud AI provider you turn on
openWith: Open AuraxNova_Command_v5.sln in Visual Studio 2022, or run `dotnet build` in this folder. The first restore downloads the NuGet packages, including LLamaSharp's CUDA backend, which is large.
